# T-2: Route impl review verdict

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Update `run-review` impl-phase post-processing so structured verdicts control PASS, retry, and next-step behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- PASS and ADVISORY verdicts do not increment reviewRetry.
- PASS and ADVISORY verdicts set next step to `gate-impl`.
- FAIL verdicts consume reviewRetry and prevent advancement to `gate-impl`.
- Registry post-hook behavior uses the structured verdict so FAIL does not mark impl review complete.

## Implementation Notes
Work mainly in `src/flow/lib/run-review.js` and `src/flow/registry.js`. Preserve existing subprocess error handling and review max-attempts behavior. Keep `ReviewFailure` retry-budget semantics unchanged unless a test proves a contract mismatch.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests in `tests/unit/flow/run-review-advisory.test.js` and `tests/unit/flow/phases-review.test.js` plus spec-local tests for R6, R7, R8, R9, and R15.
